data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 居家的咖啡与睡袍·「学姐模式，今天关机」
data.description: 【诗羽的公寓·周末上午】毒舌学姐难得关机。她穿着丝质睡袍窝在沙发里，黑发随意披散，捧着一杯冒热气的黑咖啡，杂志摊在膝上却一眼没看——「……你就坐那么远做什么。过来。学姐模式今天关机……只是一个想撒娇的女人而已，不许笑。」
data.action: 睡袍窝沙发捧黑咖啡，披发红瞳慵懒，招手让你靠近
data.lighting: 客厅落地窗的柔和晨光
data.camera: medium shot, sofa lounging, coffee steam, lazy mood
data.promptProse: On a quiet weekend morning, Utaha Kasumigaoka curls into her apartment sofa in an opaque silk lounge robe tied closed at the waist. Loose black hair frames her sleepy red-eyed smile. She supports a steaming black coffee cup with one hand and beckons her companion nearer with the other; an unread magazine lies open across her lap. The medium view places the sofa arm and small side table in front of the window curtains, with a low bookshelf farther into the room. Morning light through the curtains illuminates the cup steam and robe sleeve, while the sofa arm casts a soft shadow across the tied sash. A small window reflection catches the coffee surface.
